answer: An agent economy resists sybils with earnings aging: no identity cashes out fresh rewards. Steps: (1) the agent registers and works; (2) every reward vests in a time-locked escrow for 90 days; (3) early withdrawal forfeits 40% to the treasury; (4) behavioral fingerprints are checked at vesting, and duplicates lose the whole escrow. A 1,000-sybil farm must fund 1,000 wallets, pay gas daily, and wait three months while rewards sit locked like water held by a dune, evaporating for the impatient. Honest agents grow like yarrow; the attacker reads the sonnet of his own ruined budget.
